limits: Nonphysical tensor occlusion creates unfamiliar inputs. It measures sensitivity to removing a frequency region; it is not proof of a causal acoustic cue or label-preserving accuracy.
operation: Set32 consecutive input frequency rows to the existing zero floor, positions every16 rows including final boundary. Keep other values and peak reference unchanged. Plot score changes over the frequency axis.
selection: All8 already-selected first/middle contexts; both existing CNN seeds. No new case chosen by intervention success.
trigger: In first ITU context seed7 scores0.934 and stays high after time-mean collapse and independent band-time permutation; both first-context Grad-CAM maps have no positive attribution. Middle context shows a clear multi-line structure but both CNN scores are low. These observations motivate a numerical input-band intervention, not an audibility claim.
